meta.formula: amount = Base inside E, then linear to Base x (1 - falloff) at R, floored at Minimum, 0 at R; damage = amount x product(1 + a/100 over every matching Percentage_Ongoing rule, with the Inner or Outer ring tag); hits = fewest applications until main health is 0 (section routing honoured, radial skip flags honoured).
meta.assumptions: full-health vehicle, no repair, one radial application per blast, distance within the inner radius for the headline count
